text: {"status":"ANSWERED","claims":[{"text":"If you accidentally commit an API key to a Git repository, it must be revoked or rotated immediately and reported as a security incident under the Incident Response Policy.","evidence_id":"E1","quote":"If a secret is exposed, for example committed to a repository or pasted into a chat, it must be revoked or rotated immediately and reported as a security incident under the Incident Response Policy."},{"text":"API keys and service credentials must be rotated immediately if exposure is suspected.","evidence_id":"E3","quote":"API keys and service credentials are rotated at least every 90 days, and immediately if exposure is suspected."},{"text":"Secrets must never be stored in source code or in configuration files committed to a repository.","evidence_id":"E4","quote":"Secrets must never be stored in source code, in configuration files committed to a repository, in tickets, in chat messages or in email."}],"conflict_evidence_ids":[],"conflict_note":""}
